meta.title: D-Scholar — School management
meta.description: The platform that follows every student's schooling, from enrolment to graduation.

login.title: Welcome back
login.desc: Sign in to your school's workspace.
login.noAccount: Accounts are created by your school's management.
login.panelTitle: All of school life, in one place.
login.panelText: Enrolment, classes, timetables, grades, report cards, attendance and communication with families.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.desc: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.

updatePassword.title: New password
updatePassword.desc: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.

messages.verrou: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 1 minute and try again.
messages.compte: This account is not linked to any active school.
messages.lien: Invalid or expired link, please request a new one.
messages.mail: Check your inbox for the reset link.
messages.mdpOk: Password updated. You can now sign in.
messages.mdpCourt: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
messages.pasAdmin: This account has no access to the administration.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is the setup status of {etablissement}.
dashboard.setupDesc: Complete these steps to get ready for the new school year.
dashboard.setupDone: Setup complete: the school is ready for the next modules (students, classes, teachers).
dashboard.stepAnnee: Create the school year and its terms
dashboard.roadmapText: The Students, Classes, Teachers, Grades and Parent portal modules arrive in the next releases.
dashboard.readOnly: Your role does not allow changing the settings. Please contact the management.

parametres.title: Settings
parametres.subtitle: The school's reference data: every other module builds on it.

etablissement.title: School information
etablissement.desc: This information appears on report cards, transcripts and certificates.
etablissement.niveauMinHint: Below this level, only parents can access the portal.
etablissement.directionOnly: Only the management can change this information.

annees.title: School years
annees.desc: Only one year is active at a time: it is the one every screen uses.
annees.empty: No school year yet. Create the first one to get started.
annees.decoupageParCycleHint: For example: terms in primary, semesters in lower and upper secondary.
annees.confirmVerrou: Lock this period? Its assessments and grades can no longer be changed, and report cards become visible to families.

niveaux.title: Levels
niveaux.desc: Sorted by progression order. Only the cycles included in your subscription can be opened.
niveaux.aSeriesHint: Classes of this level carry a stream (upper secondary).

options.title: Options
options.desc: Optional subjects chosen at enrolment (second language, arts…).

salles.title: Rooms
salles.desc: Rooms used by the timetables (prevents double bookings).

coefficients.title: Coefficients & weekly hours
coefficients.desc: Choose a level (and a stream in upper secondary), then enter each subject's coefficient. Leave a subject empty if it is not taught.

utilisateurs.title: Users
utilisateurs.desc: Staff accounts. Each role only sees what concerns it.
utilisateurs.passwordHint: Share it with the person; at least 8 characters.
utilisateurs.confirmDesactiver: Deactivate {nom}'s account? They will no longer be able to sign in.
utilisateurs.directionOnly: Only the management can manage accounts.

suspendu.title: Access suspended
suspendu.desc: The subscription of {nom} is no longer active. Your data is kept.
suspendu.contactDirection: Please contact your school's management to restore access.
suspendu.contactPlateforme: Please contact the D-Scholar team to settle the subscription and restore access.

landing.title: Every student's schooling, from enrolment to graduation.
landing.subtitle: Admissions, classes, teachers, timetables, grades, report cards, certificates and a parent portal: D-Scholar brings the whole school together on one platform, on computer and phone alike.

features.cursusText: Enrolment, promotions, resits and national exams, year after year.
features.pedagogieText: Classes, courses, clash-free timetables, assessments and averages.
features.documentsText: Numbered report cards, transcripts and certificates, verifiable by QR code.
features.famillesText: Grades, absences and timetables available to parents and students.

landing.pricingSubtitle: Pay at once or in instalments, with at least 50% on the first instalment.
landing.pricingComplet: Every cycle, from pre-school to final year

abonnement.title: Subscription
abonnement.subtitle: The school's annual subscription, paid at once or in instalments.
abonnement.directionOnly: Only the management can manage the subscription.

accesDesc.lecture_seule: View only: no changes are possible until the expected payment is settled.
accesDesc.suspendu: Access is cut off. Your data is kept and access returns as soon as payment is made.

abonnement.aucune: No active subscription. Choose a plan below to activate the school.
abonnement.souscrireDesc: At least 50% on the first instalment. The next instalments fall due 3 and 6 months after the first payment.
abonnement.telephoneHint: Number used on the secure payment page (Orange Money, Wave, Free Money, card…).
abonnement.bannerNonPaye: Pay the first subscription instalment to unlock every feature.
abonnement.bannerRetard: Instalment {n} ({montant} FCFA) is {jours} day(s) overdue. Read-only beyond {seuil} days overdue.
abonnement.bannerLectureSeule: School in read-only mode: a payment is overdue.

retour.echoue: The payment did not go through.
retour.lentDesc: Confirmation may take a few minutes; it will be applied automatically.

erreurs.dejaCouvert: A subscription already covers this period.
erreurs.ordre: Please pay the previous instalment first.
erreurs.provider: The payment service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.enCours: A payment is already in progress. Wait a few seconds and try again.

eleves.title: Students
eleves.subtitle: All students enrolled for the selected year.
eleves.recherche: Search a name or a student ID…
eleves.pasDeNotes: No grades for this year (current year or student not assessed).

form.origineHint: For a transfer: the school left (shown in the academic record).

acces.desc: Generate a code for the family: with it, they create their own access (no email or SMS needed).
acces.instructions: The family goes to {url} and enters this code.

classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Classes of the selected year, with their size and staff.

enseignants.title: Teachers
enseignants.subtitle: A teacher can teach several subjects in several classes.
enseignants.compteHint: The user account (Teacher role, created in Settings › Users) lets the teacher enter grades for their own courses.

emplois.title: Timetables
emplois.subtitle: By class or by teacher. Clashes (class, teacher, room) are rejected when entered.
emplois.invite: Choose a class or a teacher.

assiduite.title: Attendance
assiduite.subtitle: Absences and late arrivals for the selected year.
assiduite.appelOk: Attendance saved: {n} absence(s) or late arrival(s)

passages.title: Promotions & resits
passages.subtitle: End-of-year decisions, based on the thresholds set by the school.
passages.aucune: No decision for this year (decisions are made at the end of the year).
passages.aucuneClasse: No decision for this class yet: calculate them at the end of the year.
passages.rentreeDesc: Re-enrol promoted and repeating students in next year's classes.
passages.pasAnneeCible: First create next year (Settings › School years) and its classes.

evaluations.title: Assessment types
evaluations.desc: Nature, expected number per period and weight of each assessment. Subject average = average weighted by type.
evaluations.seuilsDesc: At or above the promotion threshold: promoted; between the two thresholds: resit; below: repeats the year.

appreciations.title: Remarks scale
appreciations.desc: The remark given is the one with the highest threshold not above the student's average.

demo.title: Discover D-Scholar
demo.subtitle: Explore a real school in one click: Les Palmiers school (Dakar), with a complete 2025-2026 year and the 2026-2027 start of year.
demo.avertissement: No password: each button opens your own session. The data is shared by all visitors: do not enter any real information.

direction.desc: Dashboard, students and academic records, class results, promotions and resits, attendance, settings.

enseignant.desc: Mr Ibrahima Ndiaye teaches Mathematics and Physical sciences in 3e, 2nde S and 1re S2.

demo.erreur: The demo is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
demo.lien: Try the demo without an account
demo.astuce: Tip: choose the 2025-2026 year to see grades, report cards and end-of-year decisions.

parent.desc: Mrs Mariama Diagne follows her two children: published grades and report cards, timetables, absences, payments and announcements.

tarifs.title: Subscribe your school
tarifs.subtitle: Create your workspace in a few minutes and pay the first instalment online (Mobile Money or card). Full access opens as soon as the payment is confirmed.
tarifs.motDePasseHint: At least 8 characters. You will use it to sign in.

erreurs.emailPris: An account already exists with this email. Sign in to manage your subscription.
erreurs.paiement: Your workspace is created, but the payment could not start. Please try again from the Subscription page.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.subtitle: Applications for the selected year, from request to enrolment.
admissions.erreurNonAdmise: Only an admitted applicant can be enrolled.

notes.title: Grades & assessments
notes.subtitle: Assessments and grade entry by class, subject and period.
notes.aucunCours: No course is assigned to you for this year.
notes.aucune: No assessment for this subject and period.
notes.erreurBareme: Each grade must be between 0 and {bareme}.
notes.poidsNul: does not count in the average

services.title: Service catalogue
services.desc: Uniform, transport, meals, supplies, activities: price and frequency.

finances.title: Services & payments
finances.subtitle: Tuition fees, subscribed services, payments and outstanding balances for the year.
